verdict.rationale: Claude Code documents scheduling ('Run Claude on a schedule to automate work that repeats: morning PR reviews, overnight CI failure analysis, weekly dependency audits'), event-driven triggers via MCP (Telegram/Discord/webhook events 'while you're away'), routines that 'run on a schedule, from an API call, or in response to an event,' cloud/background sessions ('kick off long-running tasks and check back when they're done'), and a sandboxed bash tool for safer autonomous execution. This covers scheduled, event-triggered, and long-running background automation with strong first-party documentation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification specifically of scheduled/background automation reliability (community evidence covers general coding quality, not background automation specifically).
